content:
Apple TV's three-episode documentary series chronicling the University of Connecticut women's basketball team is now available for streaming. Watch the trailer below.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》makes its debut on Apple TV+

Apple TV+ subscribers can now stream all three episodes of 《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》, their latest sports-themed documentary series.

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》features interviews with "coaches, athletes, alumni, rivals and journalists spanning multiple eras of UConn basketball," and is co-directed by Matthew Hamachek (director of 《Tiger》) and Erica Sashin (director of 《Wrong Man》).

Here's how Apple TV+ describes the show:

《The Dynasty: UConn Huskies》joins Apple TV+'s ever-growing library of sports content, which includes 《Ted Lasso》, 《The Dink》, 《Stick》, 《F1 The Movie》, 《Fight for Glory: 2024 World Series》, 《Onside: Major League Soccer》, 《Messi's World Cup: The Rise of a Legend》, and 《Stephen Curry: Underrated》, among other titles.

Apple TV+ also previously confirmed the return date for 《Stick》 and announced a new cast member who will be very familiar to viewers of the platform's hit series 《Pluribus》.

Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, or it can be bundled with an Apple One subscription. The platform offers a range of popular TV shows and movies, including 《Ted Lasso》, 《Severance》, 《The Studio》, 《The Morning Show》, 《Shrinking》 and 《Silo》.
